hebrewText: וְ/יִֽעֲפ֥וּ נְעָרִ֖ים וְ/יִגָ֑עוּ וּ/בַחוּרִ֖ים כָּשׁ֥וֹל יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ

tokens.bdb: to tire (as if from wearisome flight)
(concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age)
tokens.kjv: babe, boy, child, damsel (from the margin), lad, servant, young (man).

tokens.bdb: properly, to gasp; hence, to be exhausted, to tire, to toil
properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective)
to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall
tokens.kjv: bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, [idiom] utterly, be weak.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs
